sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Minimalist Silver Round Evil Eye Bracelet
sourceNotes.rawContent: Shield your energy with our signature Round Evil Eye Bracelet. This sleek, high-fashion piece features a brilliant blue charm surrounded by a sparkling crystal halo. To preserve its radiant silver-toned luster, we recommend keeping it dry and storing it safely in a dry place after every wear.
